verdict.rationale: Quo documents a public REST API with API-key auth and an official MCP server. Through these, agents can send texts, pull message and call history, retrieve voicemail and call transcripts, and search, add or update contacts. That covers a real slice of the UI's core communication features, but nothing shows UI parity. Many UI features have no evidenced API coverage, including number provisioning, ring orders, phone menus, call routing and transfers, Sona configuration and AI call tags, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm the API's full surface. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for admin, telephony and routing configuration, number setup, Sona/AI features, an explicit parity statement, and a published OpenAPI spec showing the full endpoint surface.
